new: The Sound button is on the start page again: since v219 it stayed hidden until a story was picked. It shows whether the sound is on or off on this device, and a press there is kept: the story you then pick plays with sound, or stays silent.

A room without a relay (peer to peer) no longer splits when the host's link to the introduction server drops for a moment: before, the host's changes then reached none of its guests. Now the room goes on as it was.
The exposome story (Invisible threads) in a headset: the scene no longer follows your head and the beams leave your hands (a fix sent after v226).
test: Open the start page on a fresh device: the Sound button is there before any story. Press it, then pick a story: it plays with sound.
In a room without a relay: turn the host's wifi off and on for a few seconds, then change something on the host: the guests should see the change.
The exposome story (Invisible threads) in VR and in AR: the scene stays put and the beams leave your hands.
Switch on occlusion, the spaceships and the notebook: each still appears (they load on demand since v226).
untested: Everything in a headset since v220 except calibration, which the owner tried on v226: it works again.
The exposome fix is untested in a headset.
v226's parts loaded on demand (occlusion, spaceships, notebook) are untested in a headset.
The peer-to-peer fix was tried only with pretend devices on one machine.
